Quests Begun From: Aranx (NPC)
Note: These quests cannot be accessed after completing the 'Reveal the Portal!' quest.
Summon Help
Power Up!
The Final Spell Fragment
Find the Map
Reveal the Portal!
I need you to summon a friend of mine. He can help us locate the portal to underworld, which we can investigate. Before you can summon our helper you need to collect : 1 Holy Water from the waterfalls, 10 Bright Flower Seeds from your Infernal Knights, and 1 Golden Grain from the Celestial Bird of Paradise.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Excellent work! These are just what we need for the summoning spell, now you will need to learn the spell!
Items Required:
Holy Water x1
Click on the arrow on Screen 2
Bright Flower Seed x10
Dropped by:
Fallen Knight (1)
Fallen Knight (2) (Level 20)
Fallen Knight (3) (Version 1)
Infernal Knight (Monster) (1) (Level 20)
Golden Grain x1
Dropped by Celestial Bird of Paradise
Rewards:
250 Gold
250 Exp
Thanks to Dashing Draco.
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Well done Hero! Now you will have to learn the summoning spell, be aware that this is not an easy spell and you will need a lot of power. Battle Celestial Birds of Paradise until you get 10 Potions from them. You can purchase Basic Guard Potions from Skira in /embersea and the Fallen Knights have the pieces of the spell.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Well done! I can see the power shining through you! Hopefully you are strong enough to perform the spell now.

Potion x10

+ When Completed
- When Completed
That is the last fragment of the spell notes that we need. Now we can summon Ilahi Sama to come to our aid!

Last Spell Fragment x1
Click on the blue arrow on Screen 4
Rewards:
100 Gold
100 Exp
Thanks to Dashing Draco.
Requirements: Must have completed the previous quest.
Hero, Ilahi Sama needs our help to locate the portal. He wants you to collect a Map of Lore, which the Infernal Knight has stolen, and he will also need a Map Decoder to understand the readings on the map. You can get the decoder from one of the Dwakels' machines in /crashsite… just press the red button!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Well done! Now let's move to our next step, which is locating the portal to underworld!

Dwakel Decoder x1
Map of Lore x1

200 Exp

- When Completed

+ When Completed
- When Completed

The location of my brothers has been hidden from all - each of the members of the Infernal Army has a clue about the location. The minions are very strong, and they are the only ones who can tells us where my three brothers are! However it looks like they are not willing to share the information with us, without a battle! So please battle them and retrieve the 4 clues! Best of luck, Hero.

- When Completed

- When Completed

To that end, I'd like to find out how they came to be. Look around the temple, and see if you can find anything that might give us some clues. I don't know what mistakes they made, but maybe we can keep others from repeating them.

The very first opponents you'll encounter in the Arena should be easily manageable for someone of your standing. These Dark Legion Guards, Sergeants, and Gladiators are no more than grunts. Just like rowdy children, this bunch needs to be taught how to behave. Show me what you can do.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Don't feel too bad about it. If they were defeated, it just means they had no place here. Anyways, now that you what you're doing here, let's get started.

150 Exp

Thanks to Lord Vordred 101.
The next round of warriors are stronger than your typical Legion members; they are the Legion's deadliest malcontents - Paladins, Undead Legends, and Blade Masters who have forgotten what loyalty means. They are a troublesome group, and this isn't the first time they been here. I think they actually enjoy the fighting and pain. Feel free to not show them any mercy. I actually think they prefer it that way too.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I'm honestly quite disturbed at how much they seem to be enjoying it, laying there laughing and looking pleased with themselves.

+ When Completed
- When Completed
Don't feel too bad about it. If they were defeated, it just means they had no place here anyways.

You know, many in the legion already have a miniature assistant to help them out when it comes to getting the Legion Tokens Dage likes so much. Some poor souls don't seem to have one. I usually help out with that. I can't lie, I love a good show. What better way to be entertained than watch someone throw their life away for a few measly tokens? Say, Hero, wanna take part in it? I placed something that belongs to me on the Undead Rider. A brooch. Retrieve my brooch and I will hand you a generous amount of tokens. Sound simple enough?

- When Completed

Requirements: Requires Rank 10 Evil.
Every member of the Legion is undead to some degree, either through losing their physical life or forfeiting their souls. As Dage’s most loyal servants, Legion Revenants bask in death and dutifully spread unlife in the name of the Legion. Kill and re-kill Ultra Aeacus 50 times to further his strength in death, tether 300 forgotten souls to the Undead Legion, darken the essence of 500 Shadow Warriors in /shadowrealmpast, and return with contracts from 1,000 dracolich heads. The cost is high, but your reward will be great.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
You have done well, but this alone will not suffice. Prove your dedication and continue strengthening the Legion through death with your actions. Countless members of the legion desire unfathomable power, but few will earn it-- such a high cost is required for such great strength. Are you among the worthy?
